FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Once hot add the marinated chicken. Spread it out and sear on one side for 30-60 seconds. Stir fry for 4-5 minutes and once nicely browned, remove to a plate with a slotted spoon.  🔥 Add a splash more oil and add the egg, once it’s starting to set underneath, scramble and push to one side while it’s still got some liquid.  🔥 Add the rice and toss together for 1-2 minutes. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

CHICKEN AU POIVRE 🇫🇷🔥 I genuinely wonder if the French are so fed up with people butchering their cuisine that they’ve started rioting in Paris. Perhaps this recipe was the final straw. Anyway, I’m convinced you could add cream to literally ANYTHING and it would taste good. BUT IT TASTES EVEN BETTER WHEN YOU ADD ALL THE SPICES LISTED BELOW. 🤓 Crispy, beautifully seasoned chicken thighs smothered in a rich, creamy peppercorn sauce, served alongside perfectly seasoned potato wedges. If you’re on a diet LIKE ME, I suggest you look away because we’re not counting calories today. 🤝 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: 8–9 chicken thighs 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp dried thyme 1½ tsp dried rosemary 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled Olive oil Salt, to taste 🥛 For the Creamy Peppercorn Sauce: 400g single cream 4–5 tbsp coarsely ground black pepper 1 red onion or shallot, finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tbsp freshly chopped rosemary 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp vinegar ½ tsp yellow mustard or Dijon mustard 1 cup chicken stock or water For the Potato Wedges: 6–7 🙂 small potatoes 1 tsp paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp dried parsley 3–4 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste METHOD: 1️⃣ Marinate the Chicken  Add your chicken thighs to a bowl along with all the chicken seasonings and a drizzle of olive oil. Give everything a good mix, making sure every piece is thoroughly coated. Leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes, although the longer you leave it, the better the flavour. 🤝 2️⃣ Prepare the Peppercorn Sauce  Finely chop your onion, garlic and fresh rosemary. Make sure your black pepper is coarsely ground rather than finely powdered. We want that beautiful peppercorn flavour and texture, not a mouthful of pepper dust. 💀 Combine the cream, black pepper, onion, garlic, rosemary, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and mustard. Give everything a good mix and set aside. 3️⃣ Prepare the Potato Wedges  Slice your potatoes into wedges, or whatever shape your heart desires. Add the paprika, onion powder, dried parsley, olive oil and salt. Mix everything thoroughly, making sure those potatoes are generously coated. Get them straight into a preheated oven or air fryer at 180°C until golden, crispy and cooked through, turning halfway. Don’t leave them sitting around after seasoning because the salt will start drawing moisture out of the potatoes. 🤓 4️⃣ Sear the Chicken  Heat a large pan over medium heat and place your marinated chicken thighs skin-side down. Let the skin slowly render its fat and develop a beautiful golden crust. Don’t rush this part! Good things take time, and crispy chicken skin is definitely one of them. Once nicely browned, flip the chicken and sear the other side for a few minutes. 5️⃣ Bring Everything Together  Pour approximately 1 cup of chicken stock or water into the pan. Now add your prepared creamy peppercorn mixture. Give everything a gentle stir, making sure all those browned bits from the bottom of the pan get incorporated into the sauce. Allow everything to simmer gently until the chicken is completely cooked through and the sauce has thickened beautifully. The chicken should reach an internal temperature of at least 75°C. Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if necessary. 6️⃣ Serve & Enjoy  Plate up your crispy potato wedges alongside those juicy chicken thighs. Now SMOTHER everything in that rich, creamy peppercorn sauce. Finish with a sprinkle of freshly chopped chives to make the whole thing healthy. 🙂 And there you have it. Chicken au poivre with a little extra personality. BON APPÉTIT, OR WHATEVER THE FRENCH SAY.

Slow Cooker 4-Ingredient Amish Wedding Chicken 🍗 Ingredients 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup 1 packet dry onion soup mix 1 cup chicken broth Instructions Pat the chicken dry and place it in the bottom of the slow cooker. In a bowl, whisk together the cream of chicken soup and chicken broth until smooth. Pour the creamy mixture evenly over the chicken. Sprinkle the dry onion soup mix over the top. Cover the slow cooker with the lid. Cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3½ hours, until the chicken is tender and reaches 165°F (74°C) internally. Carefully remove the chicken and let it rest for 5 minutes. Stir the gravy in the slow cooker until smooth. Serve the chicken whole or shred it and spoon plenty of the creamy gravy over the top. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, egg noodles, biscuits, or steamed vegetables. Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs Get ready for the ultimate easy dinner. These bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs are seasoned to perfection and baked until the skin is beautifully shattered-crisp while the meat stays incredibly juicy and tender. Ingredients Chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Oil: 1.5 tbsp olive oil (or melted butter) The Seasoning Blend: 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano or thyme 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a tiny kick) Instructions Prep: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet or baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Dry the Skin: Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. This is the most important step for achieving maximum skin crispiness! Season: In a small bowl, mix all the spices together. Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken thighs, then rub the spice mixture generously all over them, making sure to get underneath the skin as well. Arrange: Place the chicken thighs on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side up, leaving a little space between each piece so they roast instead of steam. Bake: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the skin is deeply browned and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Rest: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving to lock in all those delicious juices. Tip: If you want an extra-shattery, charred crust, pop them under the oven broiler for the last 2–3 minutes of cooking. Just keep a close eye on them so they don't burn! #BakedChicken #ChickenThighs #EasyDinner #CrispyChicken #SheetPanDinner
